title: Coven automations SLO measured report (slo.measured.v1)
description: Evidence input for the SLO gate. A measured report is only valid when it binds the exact environment profile and the exact release artifact revisions the numbers were taken from, and when it carries a value for every measure the SLO profile declares. Partial, provisional, or unbound evidence can never pass the gate.

environment.description: The environment the numbers were measured under; the gate binds it to the SLO profile's supportedLocalProfile.

sourceCommit.description: Exact commit the measured artifact was built from.

artifactDigest.description: Digest of the exact packed artifact that was measured.

measures.description: One entry per measured value. The gate requires every measure id declared by the SLO profile to be present exactly once.
